nodes.label: SQLite to PostgreSQL Test Migration
nodes.rationale: All service unit tests were placeholdered after migrating from SQLite to PostgreSQL. The previous mock-based tests used synchronous APIs that no longer match the async Unit/Statement interface.

nodes.label: Async Mock Pattern
nodes.rationale: When rewriting tests: MockUnit.prepare should return MockStatements with async jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(...); all service method calls need await; executeStmt returns Promise<[boolean, number]> not [boolean, number].

nodes.label: Integration Test Strategy
nodes.rationale: Consider using integration tests against a real test DB instead of heavy mocking.
